You are an expert chemist, your task is to predict the yield of reaction using your experienced chemical yield prediction knowledge.
Please strictly follow the format, no other information can be provided. Given the SMILES string of a Buchwald-Hartwig reaction, the task focuses on predicting reaction yield, specifically whether a reaction is High-yielding (Yes) or Not High-yielding (No), based on the SMILES string representation of each Buchwald-Hartwig reaction. The reactants are separated by '.', which are separated from the product by '>>'. High-yielding reaction means the yield rate of the reaction is above 70. You will be provided with several examples molecules. Please answer with only Yes or No.The Reaction is as follows
COc1ccc(Cl)cc1.Cc1ccc(N)cc1.O=S(=O)(O[Pd]1c2ccccc2-c2ccccc2N-1)C(F)(F)F.COc1ccc(OC)c(P([C@]23C[C@H]4C[C@H](C[C@H](C4)C2)C3)[C@]23C[C@H]4C[C@H](C[C@H](C4)C2)C3)c1-c1c(C(C)C)cc(C(C)C)cc1C(C)C.CCN=P(N=P(N(C)C)(N(C)C)N(C)C)(N(C)C)N(C)C.Cc1ccno1>>COc1ccc(Nc2ccc(C)cc2)cc1You have to output your judge, which is "Yes" or "No", and exactly follow the output format, which is as follows:
{"answer": "The answer you judge"}. I don't need any explanation, you just need to output your judgment in the format.

Please use your tools to analyze and solve this problem accurately.

1. [ ] Identify the Buchwald–Hartwig coupling partners and catalyst/ligand system from the reaction SMILES.
2. [ ] Assess likely yield using reaction evidence and chemical reactivity.
3. [ ] Return the required Yes/No JSON judgment.

Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 2, 'search_target': 'Assess expected experimental yield for the Buchwald–Hartwig amination represented by aryl chloride COc1ccc(Cl)cc1 and p-toluidine Cc1ccc(N)cc1, forming COc1ccc(Nc2ccc(C)cc2)cc1, using Pd-Xantphos-like precatalyst and bulky biaryl phosphine ligand/strong phosphazene base. Find exact or closely matching ORD reaction records and yield if available; otherwise evaluate yield likelihood above 70%.'}

The ORD search found five records for the exact reactants and product, with reported yields of **41.0–44.1%** (60 °C, 16 h, DMSO). The listed catalysts were AdBrettPhos or t-BuXPhos, and the listed bases/reagents were MTBD or BTMG—not the specified Pd–Xantphos-like precatalyst and phosphazene base.

Thus, these records do not give a yield for the exact requested catalyst/base setup, but the closest exact-reaction evidence does **not support expecting a yield above 70%**.
